title: Explore the six journeys
intro: Choose a journey to compare actions with their expected outcomes. Proposed layouts describe improvements that still need to be implemented.
missing: This area is not available in the displayed dossier.
needsDossier: Choose a sponsorship dossier to show the journey’s areas.
readOnly: Exploring the guide does not prepare, authorize or publish anything.

agreement.title: Document the agreed benefits
agreement.goal: Document benefits from the original agreement, then have the owner confirm them.
agreement.location: Dossier Publication tab: Preparation controls, then Recorded commitments.
agreement.proposed: Bring the source, local proposal, benefits and confirmation into one continuous journey.

pilot.title: Examine promised publications
pilot.action: Select Promised publications in the Preparation controls and read the item requiring attention.
pilot.outcome: The missing check and available actions are identified without validating the agreement.

source.title: Check the original agreement
source.action: Read the saved text or document a private source containing the agreement’s exact terms.
source.outcome: A versioned source supports verification of the terms. Saving a new version starts the local analysis.

proposal.title: Examine the local proposal
proposal.action: Compare each detected clause with its quotation and identify ambiguities or terms requiring manual handling.
proposal.outcome: The details to document are identified. This local analysis uses no AI model and requires human review.

qualification.title: Document and link the benefits
qualification.action: Enter established benefits in the form, then link each clause to the corresponding benefit or explain how it should be handled.
qualification.outcome: A draft of benefits and mappings is ready for review; unsupported terms still require manual handling.

confirm.title: Confirm the reviewed benefits
confirm.action: The owner reviews the terms, provides the reason and evidence, then explicitly confirms the dossier in the form.
confirm.outcome: After server validation, the benefits are recorded in the agreement. Publication authorization remains separate.

preparation.title: Prepare publications
preparation.goal: Turn recorded obligations into drafts ready for human review.
preparation.location: Dossier Publication tab: obligations, channel cards and preparation commands.
preparation.proposed: Group obligations with their drafts and show the next action for each channel.

obligations.title: Read the obligations
obligations.action: Compare channels, destinations, quantities and required elements with the recorded agreement.
obligations.outcome: The scope of preparation is established from the documented benefits.

prepare.title: Find the preparation command
prepare.action: Examine the Prepare command on the channel card and check its destination.
prepare.outcome: After explicit execution of the available command, the platform prepares a draft for review.

draft.title: Examine the draft
draft.action: Read the prepared publication’s status and identify anything still needed before review.
draft.outcome: The draft and its limitations are visible. Preparation confirms neither authorization nor delivery.

authorization.title: Review and authorize delivery
authorization.goal: Examine the final content, destination and date before explicit administrative authorization.
authorization.location: Dossier Publication tab: channel card, then the review drawer opened voluntarily for content, date and authorization.
authorization.proposed: Clarify the transition from review to authorization, with prerequisites beside the confirmation.

review.title: Find the available review
review.action: Read the channel card’s status and identify its review command.
review.outcome: The entry point for review is identified. The guide leaves the drawer closed; opening it remains voluntary.

content.title: Check the final content
content.action: In the voluntarily opened drawer, review the text, media, destination and included sponsors.
content.outcome: The reviewer knows the exact content covered by their decision.

schedule.title: Check the date and mode
schedule.action: In the drawer, examine the proposed slot, time zone and delivery mode before choosing a date.
schedule.outcome: The chosen date and mode are understood. A proposed slot does not grant authorization.

authorize.title: Confirm authorization
authorize.action: An authorized person explicitly confirms the content, destination, mode and date in the drawer.
authorize.outcome: After server validation, authorization covers this version. Delivery still awaits the sending result.

delivery.title: Track delivery and its evidence
delivery.goal: Understand each obligation’s status and consult the available fulfilment evidence.
delivery.location: Dossier Publication tab: obligation tracking board and channel cards.
delivery.proposed: Show each obligation’s status, next responsibility and qualified evidence together.

status.title: Read the current status
status.action: Check each obligation and its associated publication: waiting, scheduled, sending, failed or successful.
status.outcome: Confirmed facts are distinguished from pending operations, simulations and uncertain results.

responsibility.title: Identify the next responsibility
responsibility.action: Read whether the next step belongs to administration or the platform and examine the displayed reason.
responsibility.outcome: The person viewing the dossier knows whether to act, wait or verify a result before any retry.

evidence.title: Consult qualified evidence
evidence.action: After confirmed success, consult the qualified evidence recorded by the platform and the available publication link.
evidence.outcome: Fulfilment can be checked against recorded evidence. This guide performs no manual evidence linking.

website.title: Prepare the website profile
website.goal: Check the public presentation, then examine its visibility independently of social deliveries.
website.location: Dossier Publication tab: Website card; presentation and preview in Advanced settings · visibility and manual tracking.
website.proposed: Create a Website profile area combining presentation, preview and visibility, separate from historical tracking.

presentation.title: Examine the presentation
presentation.action: In advanced settings, review the public slug and summary alongside the dossier’s name and logo.
presentation.outcome: The profile details to keep or correct are identified before saving.

preview.title: Check the preview
preview.action: Compare the unpublished preview with the expected presentation of the organization.
preview.outcome: The prepared display is reviewed. The preview does not make the profile public.

visibility.title: Examine visibility
visibility.action: On the Website card, read the prerequisites and the publish or hide command available for the current permissions.
visibility.outcome: Visibility remains an explicit administrative decision, checked by the server and separate from social publications.

history.title: Keep a historical declaration
history.goal: Document a declared status and historical link without treating them as proven delivery.
history.location: Dossier Publication tab → Advanced settings · visibility and manual tracking: declared status, link, notes and save command.
history.proposed: Separate historical tracking from the website profile and clearly explain the scope of manual declarations.

tracking.title: Read existing manual tracking
tracking.action: Consult the declared status, historical link and notes kept in advanced settings.
tracking.outcome: Available historical declarations are identified; their presence does not confirm delivery of a benefit.

declare.title: Enter a declaration
declare.action: Choose a declared status, enter the available historical link and explain limitations in the notes.
declare.outcome: A manual declaration is ready to save. It is not qualified fulfilment evidence.

save.title: Save the metadata
save.action: Review the changed fields and use Save in the manual tracking area.
save.outcome: After server validation, the historical metadata is retained. Saving triggers no delivery and confirms no fulfilment.
